parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of target instance. You can call [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) to obtain target instance ID.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the whitelist group for the target instance. You can invoke [DescribeIpWhitelist](~~144606~~) to obtain the whitelist group name.

parameters.name: IpList
parameters.description: The IP addresses in the whitelist group after modification. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the IP address. Valid values:

- **4**: IPv4.
- **6**: IPv6.
